text:
The verdict is **fix**: the change catches only half of the bug the brief describes. The review is in `item-validate/review.md`.

**Fixed:**
- The `{"pages":{"text":"x"}}` case is now refused by name and nothing is written. Before, it wasn't actually written to the file: it was silently dropped while the tool still answered `ok:true`.
- A line coming straight from a browser tab or `append.mjs` now gets the same check as the item tool, so an unregistered `part-*` type is refused there too.
- The old tests and the new ones pass: 125 item-tool checks and 40 page-tools checks.

**Still to fix:**
1. **The `content` case still writes.** I ran it on a temporary page in the worktree. `{"content":{"text":"x"}}` and `{"content":{"nope":{"text":"x"}}}` (a card id that doesn't exist) both answer `ok:true` and add a line to `page.jsonl`. The brief names this case.
2. **The task folder has no record of the work.** Its `session.jsonl` holds only the start line and two commit lines. It has no reproduction, no "cause at file:line" line and no closing report saying it needs a Servex restart to go live. The cause is only explained in code comments, and it differs from the brief's description, so a fresh agent couldn't pick the task up from the folder.

**Worth a look:**
- `page_tools.js:462` now loads the Page class as soon as the file is imported. Every process that imports `page_tools.js` pays that cost, even if it never touches a page. It works, but the doc should say so.
- The new line in `Servex/doc/item-tool.md` is a long paragraph with history in it. It doesn't mention the new `pages` refusal.
- `page_tools.js:417`: an older error message leaves out the `promote` verb, which the new message includes.

I made no code edits. My test script went in the worktree and I deleted it after the run.
